svg.aria-label: A zoomable mind map of consenting adult interests. Tap a node icon, line, or label to show or hide its children. Hold or double-click a node to edit its note and Favorite or Hard Limit mark. Tap a direction or everything label to open its tangential scale, then drag to choose a shade.

Unrated

g.title: Spiritual play Give spiritual play — sacred ritual or spiritual experience. Receive spiritual play — sacred ritual or spiritual experience. Practicing sacred sexuality or ritualized kink as an intentional spiritual or devotional act, using elements such as ceremony, prayer or invocation, vows, offerings, sex magic, symbolic roles, and states of surrender, devotion, transformation, or communion; the sacred meaning is part of what participants are doing, not just decorative atmosphere. 83,355 FetLife kinksters list this interest. g.title: Roleplay & identity Consensual adult roles, characters, and scenarios used to explore identity, authority, care, or fantasy. Topics in this category range from 52.8% to 52.8% common; average 52.8% across 1 with study data. Simple average of available child-topic prevalence estimates; 30 without study data skipped. FetLife: 137,428 average kinksters across 16 kinks. Average ±2σ: 137,428 ± 371,891 kinksters across matched kinks Joyal et al. 2015 (n=1,516): 52.8% average across 1 kinks. Single matched-topic estimate; spread unavailable Unrated

g.title: Clothing, materials & objects Interest centered on particular garments, materials, toys, or objects and how they look, feel, or are used. Topics in this category range from 27% to 27% common; average 27% across 5 with study data. Simple average of available child-topic prevalence estimates; 44 without study data skipped. FetLife: 232,510 average kinksters across 45 kinks. Average ±2σ: 232,510 ± 693,350 kinksters across matched kinks Joyal et al. 2015 (n=1,516): 27.0% average across 5 kinks. Average ±2σ: 27.0% ± 0.0 percentage points across matched kinks Unrated

g.title: Sex acts Specific sexual activities. Give and receive can be rated independently wherever direction matters. Topics in this category range from 38% to 82.8% common; average 60.1% across 4 with study data. Simple average of available child-topic prevalence estimates; 23 without study data skipped. FetLife: 584,547 average kinksters across 15 kinks. Average ±2σ: 584,547 ± 1,066,226 kinksters across matched kinks Joyal et al. 2015 (n=1,516): 60.1% average across 4 kinks. Average ±2σ: 60.1% ± 36.1 percentage points across matched kinks Unrated

g.title: Partner configurations Interests involving more than two people or a negotiated non-monogamous configuration. Topics in this category range from 31.1% to 59.4% common; average 42.4% across 4 with study data. Simple average of available child-topic prevalence estimates; 8 without study data skipped. FetLife: 382,828 average kinksters across 9 kinks. Average ±2σ: 382,828 ± 338,198 kinksters across matched kinks Joyal et al. 2015 (n=1,516): 42.4% average across 4 kinks. Average ±2σ: 42.4% ± 21.0 percentage points across matched kinks Unrated

Sexual or romantic attraction centered on a substantial age difference between two legally adult partners, whether the person is drawn to being the older or the younger partner. Unlike age play, the age difference is real rather than an acted role. Much-older partner: 34.2% of women and 48.0% of men; legally adult much-younger partner: 18.1% of women and 57.0% of men. Source: Joyal et al. 2015 · 366,791 FetLife kinksters FetLife: 366,791 kinksters. Single matched-topic count; spread unavailable Joyal et al. 2015 (n=1,516): 41.5% prevalence. Single matched-topic estimate; spread unavailable Unrated

g.title: Watching, exposure & settings Consensual interests involving being seen, watching, recording privately, performing, or using a particular setting. Topics in this category range from 37.6% to 82% common; average 52.1% across 4 with study data. Simple average of available child-topic prevalence estimates; 8 without study data skipped. FetLife: 166,470 average kinksters across 11 kinks. Average ±2σ: 166,470 ± 254,091 kinksters across matched kinks Joyal et al. 2015 (n=1,516): 55.4% average across 3 kinks. Average ±2σ: 55.4% ± 38.3 percentage points across matched kinks Lehmiller 2018 (n=4,175): 42.0% average across 1 kinks. Single matched-topic estimate; spread unavailable Unrated

g.title: Exhibition / voyeurism Exhibits exhibition / voyeurism — performance or exposure. Watches exhibition / voyeurism — performance or exposure. One partner exhibits — exposes their body or performs sexual activity for an audience — while the other watches; any enacted “secret” watching is roleplayed by consenting adults. About 1 in 2 adults fantasize about this (42%) Source: Lehmiller 2018 Lehmiller 2018 (n=4,175): 42.0% prevalence. Single matched-topic estimate; spread unavailable Unrated

g.title: Fluids & messy play Body-fluid or messy-play interests. Boundaries, barriers, hygiene, and specific risks should be discussed explicitly. Topics in this category range from 6.4% to 6.4% common; average 6.4% across 1 with study data. Simple average of available child-topic prevalence estimates; 12 without study data skipped. FetLife: 102,782 average kinksters across 12 kinks. Average ±2σ: 102,782 ± 134,569 kinksters across matched kinks Joyal et al. 2015 (n=1,516): 6.4% average across 1 kinks. Single matched-topic estimate; spread unavailable Higher-risk practice requiring specialized knowledge and explicit negotiation. Unrated

Average ±2σ: 40,400 ± 23,539 kinksters across matched kinks Joyal et al. 2015 (n=1,516): 49.3% average across 1 kinks. Single matched-topic estimate; spread unavailable Unrated

g.title: Rope bondage Give rope bondage — rope restraint. Receive rope bondage — rope restraint. Tying someone with rope to restrain movement, hold a pose, create pressure, or make the rope itself part of the erotic experience, including decorative ties, hemp rope, Japanese shibari or kinbaku, and historically inspired hojojutsu forms. About 1 in 2 adults fantasize about this (49.3%) Source: Joyal et al. 2015 · 29,896 FetLife kinksters FetLife: 29,896 kinksters. Single matched-topic count; spread unavailable Joyal et al. 2015 (n=1,516): 49.3% prevalence. Single matched-topic estimate; spread unavailable Unrated

g.title: Cling film Wrap cling film — tape or wrapping restraint. Be wrapped cling film — tape or wrapping restraint. Cling film is an imported variation of this: Using bondage tape, plastic wrap, or another wrapping material around part of the body to hold limbs together or create a tight, enclosed feeling. 26,845 FetLife kinksters list this interest. Source: FetLife · captured 2026-10-08 FetLife: 26,845 kinksters. Single matched-topic count; spread unavailable Unrated

g.title: Fantasy & transformation Fictional narratives, creatures, identity play, and imagined changes in body, scale, or form. Topics in this category range from 8.4% to 60.1% common; average 41.9% across 3 with study data. Simple average of available child-topic prevalence estimates; 18 without study data skipped. FetLife: 150,776 average kinksters across 17 kinks. Average ±2σ: 150,776 ± 232,919 kinksters across matched kinks Joyal et al. 2015 (n=1,516): 41.9% average across 3 kinks. Average ±2σ: 41.9% ± 47.4 percentage points across matched kinks Unrated

g.title: Crossdressing Admires crossdressing — gendered clothing or presentation. Wears crossdressing — gendered clothing or presentation. Wearing clothes, lingerie, makeup, or accessories culturally associated with another gender because the transformation or presentation is exciting. About 1 in 10 adults fantasize about this (8.4%) Source: Joyal et al. 2015 · 333,467 FetLife kinksters FetLife: 333,467 kinksters. Single matched-topic count; spread unavailable Joyal et al. 2015 (n=1,516): 8.4% prevalence. Single matched-topic estimate; spread unavailable Unrated
